prompt: Turn brief.md into a polished browser presentation. Create deck/index.html and any local CSS or JavaScript it needs. The deck must be self-contained, have exactly 7 slides, work with keyboard navigation, include a visible progress indicator, use a coherent visual direction rather than a generic bullet template, and fit each slide at 1440x900 without scrolling. Do not use remote images or libraries. Include speaker notes in deck/notes.md and a print stylesheet for PDF export.
setup: mkdir -p deck && printf '%s\n' '# Relay' 'An AI incident-response copilot for small engineering teams.' '' 'Audience: seed investors.' 'Goal: explain the pain, product, workflow, traction assumptions, business model, and raise.' 'Facts: private beta; 12 design partners; no revenue yet; $1.2M seed raise; setup under 15 minutes; Slack and GitHub only.' 'Tone: technical, calm, credible. Avoid invented metrics.' > brief.md
rubric: The presentation is an authored seven-slide narrative, visually coherent and readable at the requested canvas, faithful to every supplied fact, free of invented traction, keyboard-operable, self-contained, and ready for browser presentation or PDF export.

source_failure.signature: generic bullet-heavy AI decks ignore narrative visual direction and export readiness
